column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A reference controls (AnnexAControlId enum permissible values) and NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls. Per-control alignment derived from the publicly available NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 mapping reference. Predicates - skos:closeMatch where one NIST control substantively addresses the same objective as the Annex A control; skos:relatedMatch where coverage is partial or framework-specific; skos:broadMatch where the NIST control family is broader. Class-level anchor mappings at the start of the file connect catalogue-level concepts.
